name: Skyward Group
verdict: The unified holding-company brand of Nasdaq-listed US specialty insurer Skyward Specialty Insurance Group (SKWD), whose largest shareholders are investment firms. Nothing found.
note: Exclusive Insurance Partner and Official Front-of-Jersey sponsor of all USA Rugby national teams, announced 2026-04-08 (multi-year). Previous front-of-jersey sponsor Wasabi Technologies covered summer to late 2025.
